seo.title: Novotheatre eTicket: Case Study
seo.description: How Spectrum built online ticketing for Novotheatre: a web portal and an Android app where visitors pick a date and show, buy a ticket and enter with a barcode.

hero.title: Novotheatre *eTicket*
hero.lead: How Spectrum built Novotheatre’s online ticketing, so visitors can choose a show and buy a ticket on the web or in the app instead of queuing at the counter.

sections.title: At a glance
body: Novotheatre welcomes visitors to space shows, 5D movies, virtual reality and science exhibits. Spectrum built its online ticketing: a web portal and the Novotheatre eTicket app, where visitors pick a date and a show, buy a ticket and enter with a barcode.

items.label: What we built
items.value: An online ticket portal and the Novotheatre eTicket app

sections.title: The problem
body: Without online ticketing, visitors, school groups and families have to queue at the counter to buy tickets, without knowing in advance what is showing and when.
Counter-only sales also make it harder to plan for busy days and to keep every sale in one record.

sections.title: What we built
sections.intro: Online ticketing on the web and on Android:

items.title: An online ticket portal
items.text: where visitors choose a date and see each show with its time, duration and price.

items.title: The Novotheatre eTicket Android app,
items.text: in Bangla, with log in and “buy ticket online” on the home screen.

items.title: Shows and exhibits in one place,
items.text: such as the entrance ticket, 5D movies, VR and the digital and science exhibits.

items.title: Barcode tickets
items.text: that are checked at the entry gates.

screenshots.caption: Home: log in or buy a ticket online
Choose a date and show, such as entrance, 5D movie, VR or exhibits

sections.title: From the sofa to the gate

items.title: Pick a date
items.text: The visitor opens the portal or app and chooses a day.

items.title: Choose a show
items.text: Each show lists its time, duration and price.

items.title: Buy the ticket
items.text: The visitor buys online and gets a ticket with a barcode.

items.title: Enter at the gate
items.text: The barcode is checked at the gate on arrival.

sections.title: Results
bullets: Visitors can buy tickets before they arrive, on the web or in the app.
Each show’s time, duration and price is clear before buying.
The Novotheatre eTicket app has been downloaded more than 500 times from Google Play.

items.title: Ticket portal:
items.text: shows by date, with prices and a buy button.

items.title: Android app:
items.text: the same tickets on a phone, in Bangla.

items.title: Barcode tickets:
items.text: each ticket carries a barcode for the entry gate.

items.title: One sales record:
items.text: online and app sales in the same system.
